definitions.explanation: A voting result where more than half of the voters are in agreement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{賛成多数|さんせいたすう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{可決|かけつ}された→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧。
examples.english: The bill was passed by a majority vote.

examples.japanese: {賛成多数|さんせいたすう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: It was decided by majority approval.

examples.japanese: ⟦{議案|ぎあん}→議案：20813_gian⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{賛成多数|さんせいたすう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{採択|さいたく}→採択：06784_saitaku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The proposal was adopted by a majority vote.

notes:
{賛成多数|さんせいたすう} is a compound of ⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧ (agreement, approval) + ⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧ (majority). Used in voting and parliamentary contexts to indicate that more people voted in favor than against.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {賛成多数|さんせいたすう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{可決|かけつ}→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧: passed by majority vote
- {賛成多数|さんせいたすう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{採択|さいたく}→採択：06784_saitaku⟧: adopted by majority
- {賛成多数|さんせいたすう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{承認|しょうにん}→承認：03237_shounin⟧: approved by majority

CONTRASTING TERMS:
- {反対多数|はんたいたすう}: majority opposed
- ⟦{全会一致|ぜんかいいっち}→全会一致：09760_zenkaiicchi⟧: unanimous agreement
- ⟦{過半数|かはんすう}→過半数：05610_kahansuu⟧: more than half (the threshold for majority)

REGISTER:
Formal. Used in news reports, meeting minutes, and parliamentary proceedings. In casual speech, people would say ⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧ (there were more in favor).
